note: Approximate river course for orientation. Stops upstream of the Barretts footbridge; land at the park before that bridge and the downstream diversion dam. Exact landing connections, bridge passages and alternative channels are not mapped. No GPS remaining time or automatic planning-mileage change.

overviewReview.routeReview: Reviewed river-course overview. The dotted line stops upstream of the Barretts footbridge; the final landing approach and exact access connections are not mapped.
overviewReview.note: Dotted overview stops upstream of the Barretts footbridge. Final landing approach is not mapped; take out before the footbridge and downstream dam.

putIn.note: Course starts near the approximate access area; the water-edge connection is not established.

takeOut.note: Course stops 25 m upstream of the projected footbridge-area point. No exact ramp connection or bridge passage is implied.

review.note: Five source forks and four overlapping course views reviewed against satellite imagery; preserved original directed source vertices. Composite reuses previously reviewed upstream courses. Source query expanded beyond the new take-out; the access point was not moved.
